name: JEE Advanced
description: The sole entrance exam for admission to the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs). Only the top 2.5 lakh rank holders of JEE Main are eligible.
eligibility: Top 2.5 Lakh rank in JEE Main, Class 12 pass with Physics, Chemistry, Maths.

name: BITSAT
description: University-level exam for admission to BITS Pilani, Goa, and Hyderabad campuses. Known for its speed and accuracy focus.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 75% aggregate in PCM/PCB and 60% in each subject individually.

name: VITEEE
description: Entrance exam for Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) campuses in Vellore, Chennai, AP, and Bhopal.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Maths/Biology.

name: WBJEE
description: State-level exam for Jadavpur University, Calcutta University, and other government/private colleges in West Bengal.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Physics and Maths + Chem/Bio/CompSci/Biotech.

name: MHT-CET
description: Common Entrance Test for engineering and pharmacy admissions in Maharashtra state colleges like COEP and VJTI.
eligibility: Class 12 pass from Maharashtra State Board or equivalent with PCM.

name: COMEDK UGET
description: Entrance exam for around 190 private engineering colleges in Karnataka, including RVCE, MSRIT, and BMSCE.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 45% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, and Maths.

name: GATE
description: National level exam for Master's admissions (M.Tech) in IITs/NITs and PSU recruitment. Crucial for your profile in AI/ML research.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Architecture/Science/Commerce/Arts.

name: SAT (Digital)
description: Standardized test widely used for college admissions in the United States and other countries.
eligibility: No specific eligibility criteria; generally for high school students.

name: GRE General Test
description: Standardized test for admission to graduate schools (Master's/PhD) in the US, Canada, Europe, and UK.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree (graduate applicants).

name: IELTS Academic
description: English language proficiency test required for study abroad in UK, Canada, Australia, and Europe.
eligibility: No specific eligibility; required for non-native English speakers.

name: NSAT
description: Newton Scholastic Aptitude Test for admission to Newton School of Technology's B.Tech in Computer Science & AI. It assesses aptitude, English, and Maths.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Physics, Chemistry, Maths (min 50% in PCM). JEE Main scores are also accepted.

name: NSET
description: Scaler National Scholarship and Entrance Test for admission to Scaler School of Technology's B.S. + M.S. program in CS. Focuses on Math and Aptitude.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Mathematics. Must be under 20 years of age.

name: VSAT
description: Vedam Scholastic Aptitude Test for admission to Vedam School of Technology. Admission also possible via JEE Main and MHT-CET.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with PCM (min 50%).

name: NAT
description: NxtWave Assessment Test (or NxtWave Admission-Counselling Test) for NxtWave Institute of Advanced Technologies (NIAT) programs.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 50% aggregate.

name: KNET
description: Kalvium National Entrance Test for admission to Kalvium's Work-Integrated B.Tech CSE offered in partnership with universities like LPU, Chitkara, etc.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Mathematics. Focus on aptitude and problem-solving.

name: MSAT
description: Masai School Admission Test for admission to Masai School's software development courses. It is an aptitude-based test.
eligibility: Class 12 pass or Graduate (depending on the specific course).

name: MET
description: Manipal Entrance Test for admission to Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) campuses including MIT Manipal and MIT Bangalore.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 50% aggregate in Physics, Mathematics and optional subject.

name: SRMJEEE
description: Joint Entrance Examination for admission to SRM Institute of Science and Technology campuses across India.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology. Minimum 60% aggregate.

name: KCET
description: Karnataka Common Entrance Test for government quota seats in engineering colleges across Karnataka.
eligibility: Class 12 pass from Karnataka board or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

name: TS EAMCET
description: Telangana State Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test for admission to state colleges.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Biotech/Biology.

name: AP EAPCET
description: Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test for state colleges.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry.

name: KIITEE
description: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology Entrance Exam. No application fee is required.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with at least 60% marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

name: GUJCET
description: Gujarat Common Entrance Test for engineering admissions in Gujarat state colleges.
eligibility: Class 12 pass from Gujarat Board or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics.

name: CUET UG
description: Common University Entrance Test for admission to B.Tech programs in Central Universities (like DU, BHU) and others.
eligibility: Class 12 pass. Specific subject requirements vary by university (usually Physics, Chemistry, Maths).

name: AEEE
description: Amrita Entrance Examination Engineering for admission to Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham campuses.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 60% aggregate in PCM and not less than 55% in each of these three subjects.

name: PESSAT
description: PES Scholastic Aptitude Test for admission to B.Tech programs at PES University, Bangalore.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 50% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

name: ACT
description: Standardized test for US college admissions, similar to the SAT. It covers English, Math, Reading, Science, and optional Writing.
eligibility: High school students. Accepted by all 4-year US colleges.

name: TOEFL iBT
description: Test of English as a Foreign Language. widely accepted English proficiency test for US, Canadian, and European universities.
eligibility: Non-native English speakers applying to universities where English is the medium of instruction.

name: AP Exams
description: Advanced Placement exams (Calculus, Physics, CS, etc.) allowing students to earn US/Canada college credits while in high school.
eligibility: Ideally for students who have taken AP courses, but self-study is permitted.

name: TestAS
description: Standardized scholastic aptitude test for foreign students planning to study in Germany. Essential for B.Tech in German public universities.
eligibility: Non-EU students planning undergraduate studies in Germany.

name: STEP
description: Sixth Term Examination Paper. Required for Mathematics/CS at Cambridge, Warwick, and Imperial College London.
eligibility: Applicants holding offers from UK universities requiring STEP.

name: TMUA
description: Test of Mathematics for University Admission. Required for CS/Economics at Cambridge, LSE, and Imperial College London.
eligibility: Applicants for Math/CS/Econ courses at participating UK universities.

name: EJU
description: Examination for Japanese University Admission for International Students. Required for most undergraduate programs in Japan.
eligibility: International students wishing to study at the undergraduate level in Japan.

name: PTE Academic
description: Pearson Test of English. Computer-based English test accepted by universities in UK, Australia, and New Zealand.
eligibility: Non-native English speakers.
